Our Standards

Safety & Compliance

At Talkyd, integrity and safety are the foundations of our professional credibility.

Safe Handling Commitment

We adhere to the strictest international protocols for the storage, handling, and distribution of industrial chemicals and hazardous materials.

Regulatory Compliance

Our operations fully comply with national regulations in every African country we operate in, as well as global standards like ISO and REACH.

Environmental Responsibility

We are committed to minimizing the environmental impact of industrial supply chains through sustainable sourcing and waste reduction.

Quality Assurance

Rigorous quality control processes ensure that every product supplied meets the technical specifications required by our clients.

Framework

Our Compliance Framework

Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Detailed protocols for every stage of procurement, warehousing, and distribution.

Global Standards Alignment

Alignment with UN GHS (Globally Harmonized System) for chemical classification and labeling.

Audit & Verification

Continuous internal and external audits of our supply chain and logistics partners.

Transparency Report

We maintain full traceability of our products from source to destination. Our clients can request compliance certificates (COA, MSDS) for every batch delivered.

Commitment to African Sustainability

Talkyd integrates ESG principles into our core strategy, ensuring our growth contributes positively to the communities and environments where we operate.
